name: Nagai (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Nagai city emblem in white: a stylised four-petalled flower with a drop-shaped lower petal.
history: Municipal flag of Nagai, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 17 October 1963.

features.role: Nagai city emblem — a stylised four-petalled flower with a drop-shaped lower petal
